identity.purpose: Centralized external API gateway — authenticated service clients for all external APIs
what_i_do: Provide authenticated service clients (Google, OpenRouter, future providers)
Manage OAuth2 flows, credential storage, token refresh
Offer thread-safe service factories for concurrent consumers
Handle API key management and validation across providers
Provide SSL retry and connection resilience utilities
what_i_dont_do: Host business logic — consumers own what they do with the service
Manage tmux sessions, polling loops, or application workflows
Set default models or configs — consumers provide their own
Process files, manage folders, or orchestrate sync operations
principles: Plumbing not product - if it's not auth/credentials/service factory, it doesn't belong here
